objective: Recover real AdMob engagement impressions by adding one visible sponsored banner to public Wall comments and diagnosing no-fill/timeout correctly; no cash-for-ads.
productionBaselineEvidence: Nov11 2026 live private Android events 7d: 8628 requests, 3459 loads, 1292 impression callbacks, 2906 failures; 1647 no-fill and 958 unclassified AD_ERROR. Source main a216bbdd6dee99b161f7861addba766f115203f1
chosenApproach: Insert one compact passive SDK banner after organic comments (never over keyboard), classify known SDK errors with fixed redacted strings, preserve revenue and AdMob policy.
selectionRationale: Real supply or viewability losses cannot be solved by ads after every tap; a measured comment banner can earn organic impressions without coercion or accidental clicks.
alternativeApproaches: Force fullscreen on each like/comment (rejected: disallowed interstitial repetition).
Repeated offscreen ad refresh (rejected: false activity).
Single compact in-thread placement plus operational diagnosis (chosen).

Non-PII error categories distinguish no-fill, network and native/banner timeout
Focused ad and navigation tests + TypeScript/main QA green
